long_biography.plain_text:
Biomet co-founder Dane Miller put his belief in titanium implants to a personal test: he had a small rod placed in his arm. Its eventual removal allowed the material to be examined for compatibility with the body. He also worked closely with orthopaedic surgeons, using their suggestions to improve implant designs and shorten development times.

In Winona Lake, Miller partnered with Brent Wilcoxson to restore a declining historic neighbourhood. They bought properties, renovated homes and developed premises for shops, galleries and restaurants. They also acquired the former Chautauqua Assembly grounds from Grace College, with the aim of reviving cultural programming alongside the retail development.
